body:
### 💡 What
Added explicit `focus-visible` styles to interactive elements in the sidebar navigation (`sidebar-nav-item.tsx`, `sidebar-nav.tsx`, and `sidebar.tsx`).

### 🎯 Why
These elements previously lacked clear focus indicators, making it difficult for keyboard-only users to track their position within the sidebar.

### ♿ Accessibility
Improved keyboard navigation by adding standard `focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-2` styles, ensuring interactive elements have a clear, high-contrast focus ring when navigated via the keyboard.

# Check that the focus-visible ring styles are present in all three sidebar files
FILES="src/components/layout/sidebar-nav-item.tsx src/components/layout/sidebar-nav.tsx src/components/layout/sidebar.tsx"
PATTERN="focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-2"

missing=0
for f in $FILES; do
  if ! grep -qF "$PATTERN" "$f"; then
    echo "FAIL: Missing focus-visible styles in $f"
    missing=$((missing + 1))
  fi
done

if [ $missing -gt 0 ]; then
  echo "FAILED: $missing file(s) missing the required focus-visible styles."
  exit 1
fi

echo "PASS: All sidebar files contain the required focus-visible ring styles."
exit 0
